purpose: Bounded primary-source search for 5–8 competing mechanisms relevant to NSS; no paper download, code execution, model execution, or experiment.

queries: "Echo state network" Jaeger 2001 reservoir computing trained readout official PDF
Kirkpatrick et al Overcoming catastrophic forgetting in neural networks PNAS 2017
Hu et al LoRA Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models ICLR 2022 arxiv
Rebuffi et al iCaRL Incremental Classifier and Representation Learning CVPR 2017
records.outcome: Identified primary/author sources for LoRA, iCaRL, and EWC; official author research list for Jaeger was found. EWC and search-only sources were not selected for the final eight-source set. Search engine also returned secondary mirrors, excluded from claims.

queries: "The echo state approach to analysing and training recurrent neural networks" pdf Jaeger GMD 2001 148
"Memory Efficient Optimizers with 4-bit States" Li Chen Zhu arXiv
"Loss of plasticity in deep continual learning" Nature 2024 Dohare
records.outcome: Located author-hosted corrected Jaeger report, primary arXiv records for four-bit optimizer states and policy distillation, and the Nature article/official PubMed record on plasticity. Nature's publisher page was accessible via a cookie-parameter redirect.

actions.query: site:openreview.net/forum "LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models" ICLR 2022
actions.outcome: Search results corroborated the ICLR 2022 citation; direct OpenReview forum access below was challenge-gated.

actions.notes: The CVF search result exposed the primary paper title, authors, CVPR venue, abstract, and findings; direct open returned an internal fetch error. The LoRA arXiv record was accessible; OpenReview direct forum was redirected to a browser-verification challenge. The 4-bit arXiv v3 record states camera-ready revisions for NeurIPS 2023.

records.action: open author-hosted Jaeger report and erratum note
records.outcome: The corrected 2010 report identifies itself as a corrected version of Jaeger's 2001 GMD Report 148. Its abstract and training section state that the approach can modify only weights to output units, training a readout by regression. The PDF was read through the web viewer only; it was not downloaded to the workspace.

limits: This is a focused source check, not a systematic review. No full-source download, model/code execution, or experiment occurred. Findings are from the cited benchmark/task domains and are not evidence of transfer to NSS.
